P.name: Mortal Will
P.title: Template:Data Pantheon/Mortal Will
P.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Mortal Will|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Pantheon
|skill        = I
|icon         = Mortal Will.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Innate:}} {{ci|Pantheon}} generates {{tip|stacks}} of ''Mortal Will'' whenever he lands a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} or casts an {{tip|ability}}. At max stacks, his next basic ability consumes them to become empowered with an additional effect.
|description  = {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Pantheon''' generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Mortal Will'' whenever he lands a {{tip|basic attack}} {{tip|on-hit}} or casts an {{tip|ability}}, stacking up to 5 times. At 5 stacks, '''Pantheon's''' next basic ability consumes the stacks to become empowered with an additional effect.
|description2 = '''Pantheon''' gains maximum stacks of ''Mortal Will'' upon starting the game, completing a {{si|Recall}} channel, and [[death|respawning]].
|targeting    = Passive
|affects      = Self
|notes        = 
* The current number of ''Mortal Will'' stacks is represented by a counter under '''Pantheon's''' [[health bar]], visible to all players. It will light up when he reaches maximum stacks and the empowered effect is ready.
}}

W.name: Shield Vault
W.title: Template:Data Pantheon/Shield Vault
W.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Shield Vault|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Pantheon
|skill        = W
|icon         = Shield Vault.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pantheon}} {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target enemy, dealing {{as|physical damage}} and briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} them.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}} Bonus:}} '''Pantheon's''' next basic attack within a few seconds will strike 3 times to deal {{as|physical damage}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the front of the target enemy's location. If the target is within 800 units upon arrival, he deals {{as|physical damage}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for 1 second. Against minions and monsters, ''Shield Vault'' has a minimum damage of 60 and is capped at 150.
|leveling     = {{st|Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|6 to 8}}% of target's '''maximum''' health}} {{as|(+ {{fd|1.5}}% per 100 AP)}} {{as|(+ {{fd|0.4}}% per 100 '''Pantheon's''' '''bonus''' health)}}}}
|icon2        = Shield Vault 2.png
|description2 = {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}:}} '''Pantheon''' empowers his next {{tip|basic attack}} within 4 seconds to have a {{fd|0.375}}-second cast time and strike the target 3 times over a brief period, dealing {{as|{{pp|120/3 to 165/3|key=%}} AD}} {{as|physical damage}} per hit, up to {{as|{{pp|120 + (165-120)/17*(x-1) for 20|key=%}} AD}}. Each hit is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers and applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
|description3 = ''Empowered Shield Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Pantheon's''' basic attack timer.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|13 to 9}}
|cost         = 55
|cast time = none
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} 600
|targeting    = Unit
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = physical
|spelleffects = special
|onhiteffects = 
|spellshield  = True
|callforhelp  = true
|grounded = true
|knockdown = true
|parry = true
|notes        = 
* Applies {{tip|spell damage}} on the initial vault. Deals {{tip|basic damage}} on all the attacks from the empowered ability.
* '''Pantheon''' will be ordered to basic attack the target at the end of the leap.
* The empowered attack rolls a {{tip|critical strike}} once for all strikes; either all will critically strike, or none will. If {{iis|Sundered Sky}} {{nie|Lightshield Strike}} is ready, all three strikes will critically strike.
* Despite the multi-hit attack only having a hidden cast time, '''Pantheon''' will remain {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} until the last strike has been dealt.
** The empowered attack's total time is affected by '''Pantheon's''' {{as|{{sti|attack speed}}}}.
** {{pending for test}} The attack's total time is the cast time plus '''Pantheon's''' attack windup time.
* The 3 strikes that occur after ''Empowered Shield Vault'' each count as a separate {{tip|cast instance}} for effects such as {{ri|Electrocute}} and {{iis|Eclipse}} {{nie|Ever Rising Moon}}.
* The 3 strikes that occur after ''Empowered Shield Vault'' each apply a stack of {{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}, even if the attacks are {{tip|dodged}}, {{tip|blocked}}, or missed while '''Pantheon''' is {{tip|blind|blinded}}.
* The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}}.
* The empowered attack does not cause '''Pantheon''' to attack thrice. Effects that trigger {{tip|on-attack}} or interact with the attack windup will only trigger once and thus do not interact with ''Shield Vault''. (e.g. {{ri|Lethal Tempo}}, {{ri|Hail of Blades}}).
}}

E.name: Aegis Assault
E.title: Template:Data Pantheon/Aegis Assault
E.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Aegis Assault|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Pantheon
|skill        = E
|icon         = Aegis Assault.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Pantheon}} braces his shield in the target direction and {{tip|channel|channels}} for a brief period, during which he becomes {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}} against non-{{tip|turret}} damage from enemies in that direction. He will also strike in a cone that continually deals {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
|blurb2      = ''Aegis Assault'' can be recast within this time, and does so automatically after the duration. The channel cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}.
|blurb3      = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pantheon''' slams his shield in a cone, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
|blurb4      = {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}} Bonus:}} '''Pantheon''' briefly gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{as|{{sti|'''bonus''' magic resist}}}} after recasting.
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' braces his shield in the target direction and {{tip|channel|channels}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, during which he becomes {{tip|invulnerability|invulnerable}} to non-{{tip|turret}} damage dealt by enemies from the target direction. He also continually performs strikes in a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|{{fd|8.{{recurring|3}}}}% AD}} {{as|physical damage}} every {{fd|0.125}} seconds to enemies hit, reduced by 50% against {{tip|minions}} and up to {{as|100% AD}} {{as|'''total''' physical damage}}.
|description2 = ''Aegis Assault'' can be recast after {{fd|0.3}} seconds, and does so automatically after the duration. ''Aegis Assault's'' channel cannot be {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}} by {{tip|crowd control}}.
|description3 = {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Pantheon''' slams with his shield in a cone in front of him, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.
|leveling3    = {{st|Physical Damage|{{ap|55 to 255}} {{as|(+ 150% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
|icon4        = Aegis Assault 2.png
|description4 = {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}:}} After recasting, '''Pantheon''' gains {{pp|5 + (30-5)/17*(x-1) for 20}} {{as|(+ {{fd|2.5}}% '''bonus''' health)}} {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}}}} for 4 seconds as well as {{sti|{{as|60% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{fd|1.5}} seconds.
|description5 = '''''Pantheon''' can move during the cast time of Aegis Assault's recast.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|22 to 18}}
|cdstart      = post-effect
|cost         = 80
|costtype     = Mana
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|525|Cone radius, truncated in the back so it cannot hit behind Pantheon}}}}
|angle        = 60{{degree}}
|cast time    = {{dv|{{tt|None|Initial cast}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.25}}|Recast}}}}
|queue time   = {{dv|{{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Initial cast}}|{{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Recast}}}}
|targeting    = Direction
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = physical
|spelleffects = special
|spellshield  = special
|projectile   = false
|silence      = false
|notes        = 
* Deals {{tip|persistent area damage}} for the continuous strikes and {{tip|area damage}} with the slam.
* The initial cast counts as an ability activation for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
** Recasting the ability manually does not.<!--what if you don't?-->
* '''Pantheon''' retains his {{tip|invulnerable|invulnerability}} during the recast's cast time.
{{Effect at cast time start}}
** '''Pantheon''' will slam from wherever he was at the start of the recast's' cast time.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block the slam's damage.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Pantheon''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}}:
{{ct|channel|attack=false|move=true|cast=false|items=true,,, false|spells=true, true, true, false, false|interrupts=death}}
}}

R.name: Grand Starfall
R.title: Template:Data Pantheon/Grand Starfall
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Grand Starfall|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Pantheon
|skill        = R
|icon         = false
|blurb        = {{sbc|Passive:}} {{ci|Pantheon}} gains {{sti|{{as|armor penetration}}}}.
|blurb2       = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|channel|channels}}, then leaps high into the air. After a short time, he throws a spear at the target location that deals {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|slows}} them.
|blurb3       = '''Pantheon''' then crashes down and creates a shockwave alongside himself that travels toward the target location, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
|blurb4       = '''Pantheon''' gains full stacks of {{sbc|{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}}} upon landing.
|description  = {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Pantheon''' gains {{sti|{{as|armor penetration}}}}.
|leveling     = {{st|Armor Penetration|{{ap|10 to 30}}%}}
|icon2        = Grand Starfall.png
|description2 = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Pantheon''' {{tip|channel|channels}} for 2 seconds before leaping into the sky, causing him to {{tip|vanish}} and become {{tip|cc-immune|immune to crowd control}}. He continues {{tip|channel|channeling}} for {{fd|2.25}} seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} around the target location {{fd|0.5}} seconds into the channel.
|description3 = After {{tt|{{fd|0.8}}|Estimated}} seconds into the channel, '''Pantheon''' hurls his spear to the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.2}}|Estimated}} seconds that deals {{as|{{pp|type=[[File:Comet Spear.png|20px|border]] ''Comet Spear's'' rank|40 to 190 for 6|0 to 5|formula=40 + 30 per rank of ''Comet Spear''}} {{as|(+ 115% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}} physical damage|physical damage}} to enemies near the impact and {{tip|slows}} them by 50% for 2 seconds.
|description4 =  Over the remaining {{tt|{{fd|1.25}}|Estimated}} seconds, '''Pantheon''' crashes down after {{tt|{{fd|0.55}}|Estimated}} seconds and creates a shockwave alongside himself that travels toward the target location over {{tt|{{fd|0.7}}|Estimated}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, reduced by up to 50% for those hit at the edge of the area. Upon completion of the channel, '''Pantheon''' will lose the {{tip|cc-immune|crowd control immunity}} and {{tip|blink|reappear}} at the target location, as well as gain maximum stacks of ''{{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}''.
|leveling4    = {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|300 to 700}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|300/2 to 700/2}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
|description5 = ''Grand Starfall'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|30-second}} cooldown if the first channel is canceled.
|cooldown     = {{ap|180 to 150}}
|cdstart      = on-cast
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|target range = {{dv|{{tt|5500|Blink range}}|{{tt|1350|Landing radius}}{{plus}}{{tt|450|Landing impact radius}}}}
|effect radius= {{dv|{{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|450|Outer width, reduced damage}}|{{tt|125|Inner width, maximum damage}}}}
|inner radius = {{dv|{{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|225|Initial spear impact radius}}|{{tt|450|Landing impact radius (if not hit by the shockwave prior to landing)}}}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.1}}
|queue time   = {{fd|0.5}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Physical Magic
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = false
|spellshield  = True
|grounded     = true
|silence      = special
|outofrange   = cast at max
|flavorsound = {{sm2|Pantheon Original SFX R indicator.ogg}} ''Landing alert.''
|notes        = 
* ''Grand Starfall's'' first channel can be interrupted by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}, but its second channel cannot because '''Pantheon''' gains crowd control immunity during it.
* The spear's damage is not empowered by {{ai|Mortal Will|Pantheon}}, nor increased against enemies below {{as|20% of their '''maximum''' health}}.
* During the second channel, '''Pantheon''' gains a {{tip|minimum health threshold}} of 1.
** '''Pantheon''' will instantly die upon reappearing if he reaches this threshold.
* Abilities that target '''Pantheon''' will redirect to the last location.
* [[Ping|Pinging]] the ability will inform allies in [[Controls and Hotkeys|chat]] which {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champions are in range of ''Grand Starfall''.
* '''Pantheon''' is considered to be in his original casting position even after leaping, but he will {{tip|blink}} to the target location the moment the second channel completes.
* Using ''Grand Starfall'' will inform allies with a ping.
* If Pantheon leaves the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}} during ''Grand Starfall's'' shockwave, its hitbox will become invisible but it will still deal damage.{{bug}}
* {{iis|Experimental Hexplate}} {{nie|Overdrive}}, {{iis|Fiendhunter Bolts}} {{nie|Opening Barrage}}, and {{iis|Zeke's Convergence}} {{nie|Frostfire Tempest}} activate at the end of ''Grand Starfall's'' second {{tip|channel}}, or at the end of the initial channel if it was interrupted.
* The following table refers for interactions while '''Pantheon''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}} (first channel):
{{ct|channel|items=false|spells=false|attack=false|move=false|cast=false|consume=false|interrupts=death, ground, root, silence}}
* The cast time and second channel have the same interactions except they can only be interrupted by {{tip|death}}.
* ''Grand Starfall's'' first channel will also be interrupted if he enters or leaves the {{ai|Realm of Death|Mordekaiser|Death Realm}}.
}}
